---
title: Pip and the Very Small Cloud
author: June Marlowe
lang: en
---

Pip was a small grey rabbit with very big ears.

One morning Pip found a cloud. It was a very small cloud. It was no bigger than a teapot.

"Hello, cloud," said Pip. "Are you lost?"

The cloud did not say anything. It only rained a little, plip, plip, plip, on the end of Pip's nose.

Pip took the cloud to the pond. But the pond was too wet.

Pip took the cloud to the barn. But the barn was too dark.

Pip took the cloud to the top of the hill. And the wind said, "Whoosh!"

Up went the cloud, up, up, up, into the big blue sky.

"Goodbye, cloud," said Pip. "Come back when you are bigger."

And the very next day, it did.
